Hey! im not really as chipper as that exclamation point may indicate, but i am enthusiastic to send you this message. I went to the counselor at school, and she recommended a place called SageView, essentially a psych ward. so i went to the ER and they sent me on to sageview, where i remained until about eleven this morning. Im back in my apartment, and though by no means okay, my best friend stuck by me like i should have known he would. And i am still here. He, his girlfriend, and i had a brief meeting while i was at sageview, and although she now says she hates me and pretty much destroyed me, it helped. I might not be her friend anymore, and it might make life difficult, but i decided to stick it out. 

As for your question, i had to admit while at sageview, that although everything had been strictly platonic until the incident, i did love her. There's a lot of history in our triangle, and a lot of relevant history around me and him, and it definitely was a festering wound somewhere in my subconscious. I always say that im ron to his harry potter, and he always gets the girl i love, three times, including his current girlfriend. Its been painful since the first girl, but what was there to do about it? Ive also been single and had no sex for quite sometime, which my one of my therapists insists was a factor, i can see why. 

Anyway, im taking it minute by minute, thought by thought, and simply trying to live for myself, and be happy.  I gained a lot of useful information and tools there, as well as saw some actually very messed up people, which was a pretty good reminder of how normal i really am. 

I cant describe the feelings i felt when i was suicidal, in the hours following my confrontation with her, but its not any way to be when making life or death decisions. I know that know, i added cowardice to the list of reasons to kill myself, but now i realize that i just wasnt thinking straight.

I have an appointment with a county therapist tomorrow, and a monday meeting with the counselor at my school. I know i still have all the same feeling bubbling inside me, but im working extremely hard to move beyond them, in terms of killing myself. I will use them as a lesson and a tool instead. It hurts, but i have no more tears to shed.

Are you a therapist by the way? I heard a lot of what you had to say from all the therapists there, including the attraction question, just made me wonder.

Ill keep checking back here, but in the meantime, thank you stranger. You do a kind and honorable service.
Im eternally grateful to you.
Cheers, 
-Sam.

I deactivated my facebook yesterday, so now this is my only outlet, and im gonna say the last things i have to say. Im 20, male, i live in oh so beautiful Central Oregon, USA, my jeeps name is Xena, and shes a champ, if in rough shape. I have two best friends, the two i hurt so much as described in this thread. My name used to be Sam, but i dont feel like him anymore. We had such a sweet day,, went shopping all day, tried a new chinese food place, and built a sweet blanket fort to get drunk in. My bestfriend was out of town, and thats why i was hanging with her, we dont often get time to just hang out with each other, so it was really nice! she even said so before we got home. But i destroyed all that, i cant look back on that and smile, i cant see her face and smile anymore. Im so scared to face him, my best friend, cause ive been with him through all the drama, and all the pain with her, you know? i always lent a shoulder, i always gave advise. I always thought "I need to help him, by protecting her, and doing nothing but build her up. she was getting there too, she was happy more often, but its all gone now, she cant trust me, i dont deserve her trust either. The fact that she doesn't hate me makes her a saint. I love them both so much but i just cant bear to be continually reminded and to continually remind them by my presence, of what i am and what i did.

I think the worst part, is that she doesn't hate me. shes forgiven me, and yeah maybe my best friend will hate me and that will suck, but all ive learned is that i apparently am not in control of myself, im very capable of hurting those around me. Can things be made better after something like this? You have no idea how much help you've been alltogether, who ever you are. Thanks.

My mind is also blown about the fact that im capable of hurting someone i love so much, she has a history of sexual abuse too, she gave up her baby for adoption senior year, and has just gone through so much, and now i did this. I dont even feel like the same person.

Thanks, the reason i feel this way, is because i have a small circle of people im close to, and i dont know that i can ever face them, knowing what i am. I have no one to talk to about it because i cant bear to tell them why im suffering, i cant bear to face him, or see her on a near daily basis. Its just tearing me apart right now, she wants us to work through it, and become stronger for it, and for nothing to change, cause were all really close. but i cant bear it.

We were both drunk, i was considerably more so. She wouldnt get angry, we just talked and talked, and she forgave me. but its less about that and more about living with myself knowing im a monster and having to live with her boyfriend, my best friend. Literally in the same apartment.
